observations.body: Festivals, ascetic rules, visions, and false humility are tested. Let no one therefore judge you in eating or drinking, or with respect to a feast day or a new moon or a Sabbath day, These things indeed appear like wisdom in self-imposed worship, humility, and severity to the body, but aren’t of any value against the indulgence of the flesh.
